open_obligations: Check the CIAR numbers per system in Smit et al.'s Table 2.
Note Smit et al. later find tuned agreement can make Multi-Persona the best protocol.
Check whether the GPT-3.5-turbo versions match.
in.other_title: No protocol dominates all datasets; debate does not win on reasoning datasets
in.rationale: Liang et al. report MAD raises CIAR accuracy from 26% to 37% with GPT-3.5-Turbo, above self-consistency (29.5%). Smit et al. include CIAR among their reasoning datasets and report the debating protocols (SoM, Multi-Persona, ChatEval) do not outperform other protocols there; Smit et al. pick the best configuration per system and compare with more baselines such as Medprompt and ensemble refinement.
in.scope: proposed CHALLENGES: whether multi-agent debate beats self-consistency on counter-intuitive arithmetic reasoning (CIAR) with GPT-3.5

text: The paper reports Counter-Intuitive AR accuracy of 51.0% for GPT-4, 26.0% for GPT-3.5-Turbo, 28.0% with CoT, 29.5% with self-consistency, 27.5% with Self-Reflect, and 37.0% with MAD on GPT-3.5-Turbo.
